## Biography

Terri Tora is a xenobiologist whose investigation of rumours about a significant discovery in the HIP 87621 system triggered widespread interest in the permit-locked system. In late 3311 she stowed away on an October Consortium megaship, was discovered inside the system after circumventing its permit lock, and was incarcerated on charges of corporate espionage. Her colleague Professor Frank Raddix's public appeal for information on her disappearance led thousands of pilots to HIP 87621. In July 3312, Lexi October unexpectedly ordered Tora's release without further charges, stating that recent events and the signing of the October Accords had made continued detention unnecessary. Tora maintained that her only motive had been knowledge and that discoveries like Radicoida unica should not be kept secret.
